correctness.rationale: Every rank≤1 symmetric matrix over F2 is xx^T for exactly one binary x, because its diagonal recovers x. Thus rows of M_m are indicators of translates of the complete 2^m support inside F2^D, D=m(m+1)/2, including x=0. A fresh independently written compiled C++ bit-Gaussian elimination reconstructed all 1024 rows for m=4 and all 32768 rows for m=5, using exact xor pivots; counted pivots respectively 448 and 13658. Also reproduced complete m=1..5 rank sequence 1,4,28,448,13658. Exhaustion is finite and complete for exactly these m, not a statistical sample. Computed rates/nullities and bicycle dims by cited identities; no general m recurrence claimed.
